SheetTheme.Title: Sheet Theme
SheetTheme.Hint: Follow nationality automatically, use the original sheet, or choose a nation theme for this character.
SheetTheme.OwnerRequired: Only the character owner or a GM can change its sheet theme.

Operator.Title: Operator Skills
Operator.ChoiceHint: Choose one Operator Skill for each earned tier. Review its rules below before learning it. Confirmed choices stay fixed; you can close this menu and choose later from your sheet.
Operator.BranchHint: Add your AK5e Branch to your character to include any branch-specific options.
Operator.ChoiceActorRequired: Skill progression requires an owned character with an AK5e class in this World.
Operator.UseSkillChoices: Use Choose Skills to learn the Operator Skills your class level grants. Unrestricted catalogue learning is a GM action for characters.
Operator.SelectAllSkills: Select one Skill for every pending tier before learning.
Operator.InvalidSkillChoice: That Skill is not available for this choice, or the choice is already filled.
Operator.StaleChoices: Your class, branch, or level changed. Review the refreshed choices before learning.
Operator.FinishAdvancement: Finish or close the native level-up menu before choosing Operator Skills.
Operator.ChoiceCommitFailed: Some Skill Items were not created. Reopen Choose Skills to finish; existing grants will not be duplicated.
Operator.MultipleClasses: Multiple classes require GM reconciliation. Automatic Operator Skill selection supports one AK5e class.
Operator.UnknownBranch: The attached Branch could not be identified or does not match this AK5e class. Ask your GM to reconcile it.
Operator.InvalidClassLevel: The AK5e class level is invalid. Ask your GM to correct it.
Operator.AmbiguousSkills: Existing Skills cannot be assigned unambiguously to an earned tier. Ask your GM to reconcile the existing Skill Items before choosing more.
Operator.MissingChosenSkill: A previously chosen Skill Item is missing. Your choice is retained; ask your GM to restore that Skill.
Operator.Exception: The source rule allows gains while a Skill is active
Operator.Hostile: The creatures are hostile to each other
Operator.ActualChange: Actual damage, restored HP, or newly granted temporary HP
Operator.FromArt: Temporary HP came from an Art
Operator.FromSkill: This event was generated by an Operator Skill
Operator.NextSkillAction: Next attack or Art is part of
Operator.offensiveTemp: Grant another creature temporary HP through an Art
Operator.SetupHint: Learn Skills from the catalogue or add configured Skill feats. Enable integration to derive the shared pool and charging rates. Adding a Skill does not refill SP.
Operator.EligibilityHint: This manual catalogue can grant additional Skills. Character owners use Choose Skills for ordinary level-2/7/14 progression. Resolve exceptional grants and NPC eligibility from the source rules.
Operator.ConfigureHint: Configure source-specific exceptions here. Select all charging methods that apply, or none. Individual Skill effects are resolved manually.
Operator.ConfirmHint: Confirm the facts Foundry could not establish. Choose the original Attack to prevent charging again for its damage parts or targets. Use a separate manually resolved Attack only for a distinct Attack. Native temporary-HP actions require you to identify the caster here.
Operator.EnableHint: Charging is manual until you enable integration in Setup.
Operator.SkillRequired: Choose an owned, configured Operator Skill.
Operator.ActorRequired: Operator Skills require a character or NPC Actor in this World.
Operator.GMRequired: An active GM is required to commit SP changes.
Operator.GMAdjustment: A GM must perform this adjustment or configuration.
Operator.EnableFirst: Enable learned Skill integration in Setup first.
Operator.TimedRequired: Only a numbered-round Skill can be extended.
Operator.ReasonRequired: Provide the source rule or reason.
Operator.ActiveNoGain: SP gains are blocked while a Skill is active. Mark a documented exception if its rule explicitly allows the gain.
Operator.TargetRequired: Choose another creature for this HP event.
Operator.ConfirmFacts: Confirm the event’s source, hostility, Attack identity, and actual change.
Operator.AttackRequired: Choose the original Attack message for this Actor and event.
Operator.CommitFailed: The SP update was prevented. SP has not changed.
Operator.RequestTimeout: The GM did not acknowledge this request. Check its whisper card for the result; reuse the same request ID if retrying.

Arts.Title: Arts
Arts.SetupHint: Configure Arts Points and casting from your class, branch, or NPC stat block.
Arts.PendingSetup: Arts adoption was interrupted. Review setup to finish registering existing spells.
Arts.Summary: Maximum Art level: {maximumArtLevel} · Default ability: {ability} · Recovery: {recovery}
Arts.AbilityHint: New Arts use this default. Existing Arts keep their chosen abilities; edit an Art to change its ability.
Arts.FocusHint: Ordinary Arts require an equipped Casting Unit; source-defined exceptions are configured per Art.
Arts.FocusMissing: Equip your selected Casting Unit or configure this Art's source-defined exception.
Arts.FocusInvalid: The selected equipment must have the Casting Unit property.
Arts.UnconfiguredAP: The GM must set Arts Points and a maximum Art level before this creature can cast.
Arts.CasterRuling: The GM must record a Caster ruling for these combined AP discounts, repeat costs or origin surcharges before casting.
Arts.NinthUsed: A 9th-level Art has already been cast since the last Long Rest.
Arts.InsufficientAP: This casting costs {cost} AP; only {value} AP remain.
Arts.LevelCap: This casting exceeds maximum Art level {maximum}.
Arts.FreeExhausted: No free casts remain for this Art.
Arts.OnlyFree: This grant can only be used through its free casting option.
Arts.NoOverflow: Use advanced management for temporary AP above the maximum.
Arts.EnableFirst: Enable AK5e Arts on this actor first.
Arts.ChooseRest: Choose Short Rest or Long Rest recovery.
Arts.RecoveryHint: Recovers Arts resources only. Hit Points and other features are unchanged.
Arts.NoActivity: Reference only: configure an activity to cast this Art.
Arts.Empty: No adopted Arts yet. Add or drop an Art, or adopt existing spells in Arts settings.
Arts.ReferenceHint: Source references; casting activities and their usage grants require manual configuration.
Arts.RitualHint: Add ten minutes to the casting time; track that time manually.
Arts.ConsumptionHint: AP and limited free uses are spent only when casting is confirmed. Resolve effects and special requirements from the Art's description.
Arts.ConfigurationHint: Use your class, branch, or NPC stat block. Saving configuration preserves current AP, free uses, and the ninth-level limit.
Arts.UnitHint: The selected equipment must have the Casting Unit property in its rules. Equipment properties and Conductive benefits still require manual verification.
Arts.Unsupported: Arts integration requires the supported D&D5e activity API (5.3.3).
Arts.Overflow: Allow temporary AP above maximum (source feature required)
Arts.AdoptionHint: Adopt {count} spells as always-prepared Arts without materials or slot costs. Original casting fields are retained. Pool selection and effects remain as configured.
Arts.GMOnly: Only the GM can configure an Art's rule exceptions.
Arts.AddFirst: Add an Art to this actor first.
Arts.NoUnit: Does not require a Casting Unit
Arts.Ritual: Can be cast as a ritual
Arts.OnlyFreeLabel: Only through the free casting grant
Arts.FreeMaximum: Free casts per rest (blank = no grant, 0 = unlimited)
Arts.BlockReason: Block ordinary casting with this explanation
Arts.ExceptionHint: Use source-defined exceptions. Special attacks, performances, and Art effects still require their own resolution.

Trackers.Title: AK5e Feature Trackers
Trackers.ManualHint: Adjust counters after resolving a feature. Resolve choices, skill benefits, and effects with your GM.
Trackers.ConfigureHint: This edits the feature's existing use pool. Read its rules and enter your current remaining uses, maximum, and recovery. Shared pools, special recovery, and feature effects need manual resolution with your GM.
Trackers.Label: Tracker name
Trackers.RecordOnly: Record only; resolve the benefit manually
Trackers.LinkedHint: A linked choice applies a temporary skill benefit as a Long Rest Activity. You must own both sheets or have a GM apply it. Student improves your skill; Teacher improves the chosen creature's skill. Neither being downed nor dying ends the relationship in the published rule. Use End relationship to remove the benefit.

Tags.Title: AK5e Temporary Tags
Tags.Hint: Choose a creature whose sheet you can edit, then the temporary condition, feature copy, or native effect to apply. Set the trigger from the feature's rules. Removing the tag removes only its own effect and feature copy. Conditional rules still require manual resolution.
Tags.Label: Tag label (optional)
Tags.Copy: Add a temporary copy of this feature to the target
Tags.EditEffect: Open the native effect editor to configure temporary sheet changes
Tags.ExpiryActor: Whose turn or rest triggers removal?
Tags.Seconds: Duration in game seconds (timed tags only)
Tags.nextTurnEnd: End of the next turn (excludes the current turn)
Tags.OtherTrigger: Additional removal trigger (either trigger ends the tag)
Tags.OtherActor: Whose turn/rest controls the additional trigger?
Tags.ManualActions: Confirmed removal events (select only events the source permits)
Tags.OnePerSource: One tag in this group per source creature
Tags.OnePerTarget: One tag in this group per recipient/weapon
Tags.ReplacementFamily: Shared replacement group (use the same group for all mutually exclusive effects)
Tags.ConfirmEvent: Remove this tag after confirming this event occurred as permitted by the source rules. This button does not roll or pay an action cost.
Tags.CustomHint: Set expiry and optional sheet changes from the source rules. These settings apply to Custom tags only.
Tags.ResolveManually: Resolve prerequisites, range, costs, rolls and conditional benefits from the source rules.
Tags.EligibleConfirmed: I checked this feature grants no Arts and meets the Treatise's exclusions
Tags.RetainSource: Keep the applied tag if the source item is consumed/deleted
Tags.ConcentrationRequired: Cast the Art and start its native concentration effect before applying this profile.
Tags.CurrentTurnRequired: Current-turn expiry requires that creature's turn to be active; choose the active combatant for reactions.
Tags.ItemTargetRequired: Weapon tags use enchantments and cannot grant creature conditions or copied features.
Tags.CopyFeatureRequired: Only a feature can be copied as a temporary feature. Arts and gear use tag profiles or native effects.
Tags.InvalidCounter: Enter a whole-number resource value within the tag's maximum.
Tags.InvalidPreset: Choose a reviewed tag profile belonging to this source item.
Tags.FlockCapacity: This Flock already has its maximum number of other creatures (half PB, rounded up).
Tags.turnEnd: End of the current or next turn
Tags.OwnerRequired: You must own the affected creature's sheet or have a GM apply or remove the tag.
Tags.FeatureRequired: Choose an attached AK5e feature, Art or item as the tag's source.
Tags.InvalidTrigger: Choose a supported expiration trigger and source or target creature.
Tags.InvalidDuration: Enter a positive duration in game seconds.
Tags.CombatRequired: Turn and combat expiry triggers require a started combat.
Tags.CombatantRequired: The creature whose turn triggers expiry must be in that combat.
Tags.InvalidLabel: Enter a tag label of 1–160 characters.
Tags.Busy: Another relationship change is in progress. Please wait.
Tags.ReviewPrevious: The previous relationship needs cleanup. Have its owner or a GM remove the previous tag before replacing it again.
Tags.DifferentCreature: Choose another willing creature as your Student or Teacher.
Tags.InvalidSkill: Choose Student or Teacher and a listed skill.
Tags.ProficiencyRequired: The teacher must already be proficient in the chosen skill.

ChapterOneRules.Name: Enable Chapter 1 rule support
ChapterOneRules.Hint: Makes AK5e Chapter 1 helpers and condition markers available in this World. This does not replace D&D5e's built-in death-saving-throw workflow.

AssetLibrary.Name: AK5e Asset Library
AssetLibrary.Hint: GM-only library of named image and audio paths. It starts empty and changing a mapping never deletes the file.
AssetLibrary.Label: Manage Assets

AssetLibrary.Title: AK5e Asset Library
AssetLibrary.Hint: Register a named image or audio asset, then select or upload its file with Foundry's file picker. These mappings are stored in this World; the module ships with no artwork or audio.
AssetLibrary.RemoveConfirmation: Remove the "{label}" asset mapping? The actual file will not be deleted.
AssetLibrary.Label: Name
